concepts.def: The energy transferred when a force moves its point of application: W = Fs cos θ, measured in joules.
Energy of a moving body: E_k = ½mv², measured in joules.
Energy stored due to position in a gravitational field, near Earth: E_p = mgh.
Energy cannot be created or destroyed, only transferred between forms.
The rate of doing work or transferring energy: P = W/t = Fv, measured in watts.
Ratio of useful output energy to total input energy, often expressed as a percentage.
